CONSULAT GÉNÉRAL
DE
BELGIQUE

Nos 776 / C1:436

Shanghai, 13th September 1939

〔此处转录不清：右上角印章及手写编号区域，包含 "No 8927"、"SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE"、"S. B. RY"、"No. S. B. D. 947"、"Date" 等字样〕

Sir,

I have the honour to request your kind
assistance with a view to locating the present
whereabouts of a Belgian subject, A. VERLEYSEN,
who is reported to be residing in Shanghai.

From the scant information in my possession
it appears that A. Verleysen should have arrived here,
probably from Europe, some time in June or July
last, possibly even during May. Verleysen was
actually in Shanghai at the end of 1938 or beginning
1939 and resided for some time at the Park Hotel.
During the latter part of 1937 and in 1938 he seems
to have resided in the Hongkew district. It is
therefore not impossible that he might at present
again have fixed his residence in that district
since his return from Europe.

Thanking you in anticipation for any
possible information you may be able to gather on
this subject, I remain, Sir,

Yours faithfully,

The Acting Consul General for Belgium

〔此处转录不清：手写签名〕

To the Commissioner of the
Shanghai Municipal Police.

比利时
总领事馆

第 776 / C1:436 号

上海，1939年9月13日

〔此处转录不清：右上角印章及手写编号区域，包含 "No 8927"、"SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE"、"S. B. RY"、"No. S. B. D. 947"、"Date" 等字样〕

先生：

谨请阁下协助查找比利时籍公民 A. VERLEYSEN 目前的下落，据报其居住于上海。

根据我所掌握的有限信息，A. Verleysen 似乎应于去年六月或七月间，甚至可能在五月，抵达此地，大概是从欧洲而来。Verleysen 实际上在1938年底或1939年初曾在上海，并在国际饭店居住了一段时间。在1937年下半年及1938年期间，他似乎居住在虹口区。因此，自他从欧洲返回后，目前再次将该区作为居住地并非不可能。

预先感谢阁下就此事项可能收集到的任何信息，此致

敬礼，

比利时代理总领事

〔此处转录不清：手写签名〕

致
上海公共租界工部局警务处处长。

CONSULAT GÉNÉRAL
DE
BELGIQUE

No.1015/31:436.

Shanghai, 16 November 1939.

〔此处转录不清〕

Dear Sir,

I have the honour to acknowledge receipt of your
letter of the 7th instant, No.E.2927, informing me of the
address of the Belgian subject Mr. A. Verleysen.

I thank you for your valuable assistance in helping
me to locate this person and thus enabling me to get into
touch with him. I may add that Mr. Verleysen has again
changed residence and is now staying at the New Asia
Hotel, Nanking Road.

I remain, dear Sir,

Yours faithfully,
The Acting Consul General for
Belgium.

(L. Scheyven)

（印：SHANGHAI 18 NOV 1939 COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE）

Major E. H. Bourne, M.C.,
Commissioner of Police,
Shanghai Municipal Council,
SHANGHAI.

亲爱的先生：

谨此确认收到您本月7日第E.2927号来函，告知我比利时籍公民 A. Verleysen 先生的地址。

感谢阁下的宝贵协助，帮助我找到此人，从而使我能够与他取得联系。补充说明的是，Verleysen 先生再次更换了住所，现住在南京路的新亚酒店。

此致

敬礼，
比利时代理总领事。

(L. Scheyven)

REPORT
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S. B REGISTRY No. S. B ( ) Station 3 Date March 14, 1940）

Subject...... Mr. Ernest John Herod.

Made by... D.J. McKeown....................Forwarded by.... Supt. J. Mason

Mr. Ernest John Herod arrived in Shanghai
from Soerabaja on September 4, 1939 in the
Java China Japan Lijn s.s. "Tjisadene". A
scrutiny of the books of the shipping company
shows that he left no forwarding address, and
the only point of interest is that his name on
the passenger list is followed by the remark
"not to be readmitted into Java" by order of
the Immigration authorities. He left Shanghai
for Hongkong on the s.s. "Kingyuan" of the B.
& S. Line but enquiries at the shipping company
have produced no results. The date of his
departure was September 24, 1939. There is
no information regarding his stay in Shanghai.
He did not reside in any of the local hotels
under the name of Herod, nor at any boarding
house. He is not mentioned in Police records.

〔此处有手写批注，字迹潦草难以辨认〕

D. C. (Special Branch).

J M : Krown
D.      S.

（印：INDEXED BY: (S.B.) REGISTRY DATE 14/ 3 / 40）

事由 ____ Ernest John Herod 先生。

由... D.J. McKeown 呈报 ____ 经 ____ 督察 J. Mason 转呈

Ernest John Herod 先生于1939年9月4日乘坐爪哇-中国-日本轮船公司（Java China Japan Lijn）的“芝萨达尼”号（s.s. "Tjisadene"）轮从泗水（Soerabaja）抵达上海。查阅轮船公司的记录显示，他未留下转寄地址，唯一值得注意的一点是，乘客名单上他的名字后面附有移民局当局命令注明的“不准再次进入爪哇”的备注。他乘坐宝丰洋行（B. & S. Line）的“金源”号（s.s. "Kingyuan"）轮离开上海前往香港，但向轮船公司查询未果。他的离境日期为1939年9月24日。关于他在上海停留期间没有任何信息。他未以 Herod 之名居住在任何本地旅馆或寄宿公寓中。警察记录中也没有提到他。

〔此处有手写批注，字迹潦草难以辨认〕

副巡官（特别科）。

J M : Krown
D.      S.
